ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, Jia on the left is a contour topographic map. It can be seen that in the middle there is a roughly north-south elongated low-lying or river zone, and the contour lines bend near this zone, indicating that this place corresponds to a valley. Yi on the right is a geological distribution map. The rock strata or fossil-bearing strata are distributed symmetrically left and right: the middle is an area containing trilobite fossils, the two sides are successively areas containing dinosaur fossils, and the outermost sides are areas containing hominoid fossils. Then reason: Trilobite fossils are the oldest in age, dinosaur fossils are newer, and hominoid fossils are the newest. Therefore, Figure Yi shows strata that are old in the center and new on the two wings, which is the identifying feature of an anticline structure; in Figure Jia, the same central position appears as a river or low-lying valley, indicating that the top of the anticline has been eroded to form a valley. From this, it is judged that the geological structure and landform combination of this region is an anticline forming a valley.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：甲图是等高线地形图，中央附近有河流或低洼带；乙图是地质分布图，岩层/化石带左右对称，中心为含三叶虫化石地区，两侧依次为含恐龙化石地区、含类人猿化石地区。再推理：根据三叶虫—恐龙—类人猿由老到新的化石时代顺序，中心老、两翼新判定为背斜；根据甲图河流和等高线形态判定中心对应谷地；所以该地区是背斜成谷。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左侧甲为等高线地形图，可见中部有一条大致南北向的狭长低洼或河流地带，等高线在该带附近弯曲，说明这里对应谷地。右侧乙为地质分布图，岩层或含化石地层呈左右对称分布：中间为含三叶虫化石的地区，两侧依次为含恐龙化石的地区，最外侧为含类人猿化石的地区。再推理：三叶虫化石时代最老，恐龙化石较新，类人猿化石最新，因此乙图显示地层中心老、两翼新，这是背斜构造的判别特征；甲图中同一中心位置表现为河流或低洼谷地，说明背斜顶部受侵蚀形成谷地。由此判断该地区的地质构造与地形组合为背斜成谷。
